card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a long drug or brand name, such as rap in rapamycin, lon in monoclonal, or AV in TAVNEOS. It also fires on the first letter of an abbreviation like CNS.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of an upper-case brand name, before the name is finished.
